profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Ruby on Rails, React & Product Architecture | @ Monetary
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer specializing in Ruby on Rails and React, with experience building and evolving high-trust products in fintech and operational software.

My path is unusual and it's an advantage: I started in design, moved through frontend, and grew into full-stack and backend engineering. That means I understand products from the pixel to the database, and I've owned systems end-to-end. Every role taught me something: Design taught me empathy, Marketing taught me business outcomes, Engineering taught me systems, and Product discovery taught me how to identify the real problem.

At Betterment, I progressed through four engineering roles over 4.5 years, ultimately becoming a Senior Software Engineer. I worked across customer-facing experiences, internal platforms, APIs, and complex product workflows where data integrity, production reliability, and user trust were essential.

My strongest work sits at the intersection of product engineering and system design. I translate business rules into durable software models, design workflows with clear state transitions and failure handling, and help teams make sound architectural decisions without losing sight of the customer or business outcome.

My core experience includes:
- Ruby on Rails, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, GraphQL and Redis
- Product and domain modeling for complex business workflows
- API and platform integrations
- Background processing, idempotency and production reliability
- Technical design, code review and cross-functional collaboration
- Practices system design, distributed systems, API/platform integrations, AI-assisted workflows

I’m currently building a field-operations platform for a plumbing and septic business, unifying customer, property, scheduling, pricing, and service workflows. Several of my past freelance builds (ProSun, Ripple IT, and Spoken Here) remained in production for five to eight years or are still serving clients today. The ones that have gone through redesign retained many of the product and interaction patterns I originally introduced.

I’m most interested in Software Engineer opportunities where I can contribute across implementation, product architecture and technical strategy, particularly on teams building reliable systems with Ruby on Rails and React.

Open to Senior Software Engineer roles (Ruby on Rails / React), remote, starting conversations in August.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Freelance Sotware engineer
positions.description:
I design and build operational software and customer-facing digital products for small and midsize businesses, working from product discovery and domain modeling through implementation and production delivery.

March 2026 – Present: Independent Software Engineer
- Building a Rails-based field-operations platform for a plumbing and septic business, modeling customers, properties, service tickets, appointments, pricing and operational workflows within a consistent system of record.

Aug 2018 – 2021: Designer & Web Developer
- Designed and developed websites, product experiences and marketing systems for organizations across professional services, technology, manufacturing and consumer businesses.
- Selected work included Spoken Here, Ripple IT, ProSun International. Several projects remained in active use for 5+ after delivery, reflecting an emphasis on practical design and system architecture, usability and long-term business value

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Owned and helped to evolved product capabilities within Betterment’s acquisition and promotions platform, supporting incentive programs across retirement, investing, savings, checking, and employer-sponsored 401(k) products.
- Designed and reviewed changes across Ruby on Rails and React systems, with particular attention to lifecycle state, data integrity, failure handling and long-term maintainability.
- Led the engineering delivery of a configurable B2B program, translating complex eligibility, enrollment, account and investment requirements into reliable product workflows.
- Served as a Platform PR reviewer for a team of engineers, providing detailed technical feedback before changes are deployed to production

positions.title: Senior Website Experience Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
- Expanded from customer-facing web development into broader full-stack product ownership across Betterment’s acquisition systems and shared platform capabilities.
- Contributed to architectural planning and technical reviews for changes spanning frontend applications, backend services and platform integrations.

positions.title: Lead Website Experience Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
- Expanded the role of the website experience team beyond page delivery toward maintainable product engineering.
- Led implementation and technical coordination for customer-facing website initiatives within Betterment’s acquisition organization.
- Reviewed implementation approaches, supported other developers and helped ensure work met platform and production-quality expectations.

positions.title: Website Experience Developer
positions.description:
- Translated product and design requirements into accessible, responsive and production-ready experiences across Betterment’s marketing platform.
- Worked within a cross-functional engineering environment where experimentation, data quality, reliability and customer trust were central to delivery.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Developed responsive, conversion-focused websites and digital experiences for clients across multiple industries.
- Translated design and marketing requirements into maintainable frontend implementations, collaborating with strategists, designers and client stakeholders.

positions.title: Front-end Web Developer & Graphic Designer
positions.description:
- Progressed from visual design into frontend development, designing and building websites, landing pages and reusable digital experiences for a broad client portfolio, both domestic and international.
- Owned work from early concepts and wireframes through implementation, quality assurance and production delivery.
- Collaborated with marketing, content and client teams to translate business goals into usable, conversion-oriented digital products.

positions.title: Design And Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed ProSun International’s primary product and marketing website, creating a clearer digital experience for its commercial tanning and wellness equipment.
- Established the site’s information architecture, product presentation and core interaction patterns from design through production delivery.
- The resulting experience remained in use for approximately 8 years, and many of the structural and product-presentation patterns were retained when the company went through a redesign.
- Also contributed to product specifications and supporting sales materials to improve consistency across the company’s digital and physical customer experience.

positions.title: Contract Designer and Website Developer
positions.description:
• Served as Creative Director for ProSun International, a leading manufacturer of luxurious tanning and massage beds.  
• Designed and developed the main marketing website, generating numerous qualified marketing leads.  
• Updated product spec sheets and created marketing materials, including flyers, ebooks, and newsletters.  
• Trained and mentored the new design team to enhance their skills and efficiency.

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
- Partnered closely with company leadership to redesign product packaging, catalogs and sales materials for a growing consumer-security product line.
- Created a more cohesive product presentation across packaging, web and trade-show materials, helping the sales team communicate product value more effectively.
- The redesigned product experience contributed to stronger sales execution, including the company’s largest deal of that year and direct feedback that the products had become substantially easier to sell.
- Improved the way the company presented its products, reduced friction in the sales conversation, and supported a major commercial result.

positions.title: Graphic Design Internship
positions.description:
• Provide support to Graphic Design & Creative team, including assisting with designing seals, and silhouetting
• Design seals for brand identity
• Worked independently on assigned projects, as well as reach out to other team members to ensure all projects are completed in a timely manner
• Proof read design for typing error, etc.
